बच के रहना रे बाबा, बॉलीवुड की हमारी फेवरेट कुड़ी अब 'गुड गर्ल' बनकर नहीं रहना चाहती! 🎬✨

करीना कपूर के शो What Women Want में कृती सेनन ने किया बड़ा खुलासा। 🤩
कृती का कहना है कि करियर की शुरुआत में उनके पास लिमिटेड ऑप्शंस थे। 🧐
उन दिनों महिलाओं को सिर्फ 'सती सावत्री' यानी शर्मीली और 'गुड गर्ल' के रूप में ही दिखाया जाता था। 🙄
कृती ने बताया कि वह ऐसे सीधे-साधे किरदार निभाते-निभाते पूरी तरह बोर हो चुकी थीं। 🥱
हाल ही में फिल्म Do Patti में डबल रोल निभाकर उन्हें फाइनली कुछ अलग और मजेदार करने का मौका मिला। 💃
12 साल के लंबे करियर में Mimi जैसी हिट और नेशनल अवॉर्ड जीतने वाली कृती अब फिल्मों में रियल और ग्रे शेड्स वाले किरदार चाहती हैं। 🏆🔥

क्या आप भी फिल्मों में हीरोइन का संस्कारी अवतार देखकर बोर हो गए हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇💬

ctx.title: Kriti Sanon was tired of playing good girl roles early in her career, says it is refreshing to see more realistic parts for women being written
ctx.summary: Kriti Sanon shared that most female roles in films are written from the male gaze and have little to do in the narrative other than serve the hero.
ctx.text:
Kriti Sanon has come a long way since making her Hindi film debut with Heropanti. From winning a National Award for Best Actress to opening her own production house, the actor has tried to experiment with her career and take chances. In an episode of What Women Want with host Kareena Kapoor, the actor has now opened up about the kind of roles she wants to do after doing 20 films in her career.
When Kareena asked her about the kind of role she wants to try that keeps her out of the comfort zone. To this, Kriti said that when she was new to the industry she was aware of choosing the best out of the few things that was offered to her in terms of characters. She shared, “You don't have all amazing opportunities instantly. For a very long time, it was like the good girl. For a long time, the woman is seen from the male gaze. Which is ‘sati savitri’ (good girl), coy, shy, one who has to be saved from the hooligans… never does the wrong thing.”
“It is refreshing that people are now writing parts that are more real, more human, not necessarily white, human enough to make mistakes and does things that may not be morally right… and I was bored of doing the good girl parts. In life, in general I have the good girl syndrome…” she added.
The actor then went on to share the experience of doing double roles in Do Patti, and how playing a complex character who is mean and selfish really felt like a change. Kriti then gave example of Joaquin Phoenix's performance in Joker and how the audience stills roots for that character and sees the pain.
Over her 12-year-long career, Kriti has proved her mettle time and again. She won the National Award for her performance in Mimi and has starred in successful projects such as Bareilly Ki Barfi, Dilwale, Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya, Crew, and more. She earned praise for her performance in Homi Adajania's Cocktail 2.

When not watching films or speaking to celebrities, Santanu can be found reading a book. Some of his favourite films are Aparajito, Ponyo and The Double Life of Veronique. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own.

Santanu continues to write passionately about films and celebrity culture. He brings a relatable, as well as critically informed, lens to entertainment and culture for a wide audience.
